newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha still well bid, backwardation steep.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha still well bid, backwardation steep.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Monday as traders continued to show strong bids for a prompt pipeline spec cargo and the backwardation remained very strong, dealers said.
Trader bids at $230 cif NWE for a pipeline spec cargo in October supported the front end and November prices gained $4.00-5.00 to $220.00-221.00 a tonne.
The recent strength of naphtha versus Dated Brent hit reforming margins, but refiner demand was sustained by its need to supply hydrogen to desulphurisation units.
